note: Independent expanded cohort data confirms speech delay is present in 20/21 (95%) individuals, outperforming facial dysmorphism (67%) and behavioral dysregulation (62%).

evidence.text: In an expanded cohort of 21 individuals with FBXO11 variants, speech delay was documented in 20 of 21 cases (95%), outperforming facial dysmorphism (67%) and behavioral dysregulation (62%).

source.title: Defining FBXO11-Related Neurodevelopmental Disorder: Clinical, Molecular and Facial Assessment of 21 Patients
source.quote: Speech delay was observed in 20/21 cases (95%).
